# git main

Add a `git main` command that renames a checked-out `master` branch to `main` and re-attaches it to the renamed remote branch:

```bash
$ git branch -m master main
$ git fetch origin
$ git branch -u origin/main main
$ git remote set-head origin -a
```

This is the client side of a default-branch rename on GitHub: after the server-side rename every local clone has to be fixed by these four commands, and the author had dozens of clones.
